question: Estimate the market size for fleet management software for Indian logistics + transport companies.
idealClarificationQuestions: Fleet management software: GPS tracking + driver behavior + fuel monitoring + maintenance? Yes.
Indian B2B logistics + transportation companies? Yes.

calculationFlow: Indian commercial vehicles operational: ~1.5 crore (trucks + buses + LCVs).
Vehicles in organized fleets (>50 vehicles per fleet): ~25-30 lakh.
Of these, currently using fleet management software: ~25-30% = ~7-8 lakh vehicles.
Average ARPU per vehicle per year: ~₹3,000-5,000 (GPS device + monthly tracking + analytics).
Including aftermarket GPS hardware (Logsmate, Mahindra Onroadz, RouteMobile, Locus): ~₹500-700 Cr.
